description: This file defines the GatewayConnectivityCoordinator class responsible for managing the connection state to a gateway endpoint within the application. It includes handling endpoint state updates, resolving URLs, and initiating refresh actions when the endpoint changes.

classes.name: GatewayConnectivityCoordinator
classes.description: Manages the connection state to a gateway endpoint, handling connection updates, URL resolution, and state transitions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins listening for endpoint state updates by subscribing to the GatewayEndpointStore stream.

methods.name: handleEndpointState
methods.description: Updates internal state based on new endpoint status and triggers refresh actions when the endpoint changes.

methods.name: hostLabel(for:)
methods.description: Generates a string label for a URL's host, including port if available.
